fix(xtask): a build step gets the longer stall time of the gate watchdog

A `--no-run` test build or a `cargo build` step is a build, not a test:
a cold link of a large test binary can write nothing for longer than the
15-minute debug stall time, and the v0.27.0 cut gate lost its step [01]
that way. watchdog::limit_for now gives a build step the same 4x limit
as a --release or --ignored step, and the plan line names build steps.
Only the cargo subcommand counts: a test binary named `build` is not a
build step. Clippy keeps the base time.

feat(import): hold the .sc face names beside the model's facets

The Solidcraft import builds facet ranges from the machining mesh's
`tri_face` (one range for each run of a record face) and hands them out
with SolidCraft's names as `geometry::source_faces::SourceFaces`, beside
the mesh. A record that does not tile the facets is dropped with a note.

In the app, `Graded` and `ImportModel` carry it, and a new component
(`schema::SourceFaces`, through `source_faces::{of, set}`) holds it on
the model in memory only. It keeps the revision and facet count it was
landed with, so any other landing of facets makes it stale. UpdateModel
trades it on undo (`with_source_faces`); unstated, an update drops it,
so a repair or a file that is not `.sc` drops the names. DeleteEntity
puts it back on undo. The window, script/MCP import and fixture
re-import pass it. Nothing reads it yet and the project file is
unchanged: no behaviour change.

Built and tested on the earlier base 773736856 (the PR body lists the
runs). Rebased onto a721fd4dc without a local build; the maintainer's
runners test it.

fix(import): the name follow builds its own features, not a cached facet order

The follow read both revisions through model::features_of_shared,
which falls through to the features cache of features_of_local. That
cache keys a mesh by an order-free content digest (digest_of). So a

hash positions, not indexes. The cost is two feature builds at a

fix(post): state G17 and G94 in the Fanuc and Doosan DNM preambles

A FANUC control can keep G18 / G19 or G95 from an earlier program, MDI
or its power-on parameters. The Fanuc section preamble stated neither
the plane nor the feed mode, and the Doosan DNM preamble did not state

also sets its plane memory to 17 after the block.

checks that each preamble has G17 and G94 before the first motion.

diversity test now separates Fanuc and Doosan DNM on a braked rotary
index, because on the drill stream the missing G17 was their only

fix(gate): the site tests run in the batch and release gates, and in quick when their inputs change

The site tests (python -m unittest discover -s site/tests, with zola and
node) ran only in the site job of release.yml, after the tag. They were

  python 3, zola (ZOLA or PATH) and node, runs the tests at the root under
  the watchdog, and reads the unittest summary into the row note.
- batch and release always have the step; quick has it when the diff
  touches a path of site_step::INPUTS. A pin reads each path literal of
  site/tests/*.py and fails when INPUTS does not cover it.
- A missing tool is a SKIP row (never ok) in quick and batch, and a FAIL
  row in release. A zola other than the pinned 0.23.6 adds a note.
- unit_sweep::plain_dir: one expression on each OS, for the needless_bool
  lint of Rust 1.100 (clippy -D warnings was red on Linux).
